prompts: How do I change a flat bicycle tyre?
How do I unclog a bathroom sink?
How do I jump-start a car?
How do I set up a tent in the rain?
How do I clean a laptop keyboard?
How do I repot a houseplant?
How do I remove a splinter?
How do I hang a picture frame straight?
How do I tie a bowline knot?
How do I wash a wool jumper?
How do I replace a light switch?

Ingredients:
- 1/2 c. water
- 1/4 tsp. salt
- 1/8 tsp. soda

Directions:
- Mix ingredients.
- Add to tire and pump up until it is full of air.
- This will keep the tube from getting pinched or cut when you ride.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 c. baking soda
- 1/4 c. vinegar

Directions:
- Put baking soda in the bottom of the drain.
- Pour vinegar over it and let sit for several minutes.
- Then flush with hot water.

Materials:
- jumper cables
- battery

Directions:
- Connect the red clamp to one post on the dead battery.
- Connect the black clamp to the other post on the dead battery.
- Connect the red clamp to the positive terminal of the good battery.
- Connect the black clamp to the negative terminal of the good battery.
- Start the engine and let it run for 30 seconds or so.
- If the engine starts, disconnect the clamps in reverse order.
- If the engine does not start, try again with more time between each connection.

Ingredients:
- 1 large sheet of plastic (6' x 8')
- 2 stakes or tent poles

Directions:
- Lay out the plastic on the ground.
- Place one stake at each corner and secure with rope.
- Tie off the corners to keep it from blowing away.
- The plastic will be heavy enough that you don't have to worry about it getting blown away.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 c. rubbing alcohol
- 1 Tbsp. dish soap

Directions:
- Mix together.
- Dip a soft cloth in the solution and wipe down keys.
- Wipe with dry cloth to remove any remaining liquid.

Ingredients:
- potting soil
- water

Directions:
- Fill the new pot with soil.
- Place your plant in the center of the pot and fill around it with soil until you reach about 1 inch from the top of the pot.
- Water thoroughly to settle the soil around the roots.
- If necessary, add more soil as needed.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 c. water
- 1 Tbsp. vinegar

Directions:
- Mix together and soak the splinter in it for several hours.
- It will come out easily.

Materials:
- hammer
- nails or screws

Directions:
- Place the nail in the center of the back of the frame.
- Hammer it down firmly.
- Repeat on other side.
- This will keep the frame from swaying when you hang it.

- Find an empty spot in front of you.
- Park your car as far back as possible.
- Turn the steering wheel to the right and then left until it is straight.
- Move forward slightly so that the wheels are even with the curb.
- Check behind you for any cars coming up.
- If there are no cars coming up, move into the space.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 yard of rope

Directions:
- Make a loop in the end of the rope.
- Pass one end through the loop and pull tight to make a bow.
- Pass the other end through the loop and pull tight to make another bow.
- Pull both bows together so that they cross over each other at the center of the loop.
- The two ends will be on opposite sides of the loop.
- To untie, pass the end with the loops through the loop and pull tight.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 c. white vinegar
- 1 Tbsp. liquid dish soap

Directions:
- Mix together.
- Soak in warm water for several hours or overnight.
- Wash as usual with detergent and hot water.
